title: The Cape Region
text: The Cape Floristic Region (CFR) is located at the southern tip of Africa, mainly in the Western Cape province. Despite being a relatively small area, it has exceptional plant diversity.

title: Fine Bush
text: The dominant vegetation is called 'fynbos' (pronounced 'fain-boss'), which is Afrikaans for 'fine bush' referring to the fine, small leaves of many plants. The protea (South Africa's national flower) is a famous fynbos plant.
